workflow print status 
=======================

Synopsis
""""""""

**workflow print status** [*options*]

Description
"""""""""""

Prints a list of SPoint statuses organized by sweeps and stages within each sweep.

Options:
""""""""""

**-s** *stage_name*, **\--stage** *stage_name*
   A stage name to filter the printed SPoint statuses.
   Defaults to "all".

**-w** *sweep_name*, **\--sweep** *sweep_name*
   A sweep name to filter the printed SPoint statuses.
   Defaults to "all".
